rows.en: But someday, I want to reach the same heights.

They're really amazing, you know.
They breeze through things I can't do...

They started after me,
but they passed me in no time.

Honestly, it was a bit of a shock.
But I keep telling myself: someday, for sure!
I see. I'm sure you can do it, Luca!

Thank you!
Sorry for suddenly bringing up
something so weird...

No, don't worry about it at all.
Come on, let's finish eating, get our strength
up and give it our all again from tomorrow!
Yeah, see you!
(So even Luca has his worries...)
(I came to eat with Luca-kun, but...)

What's wrong, Luca-kun?
You look kind of down...

You've barely touched your food, either.
Is the food here not to your taste?
What's this all of a sudden?

Hmm, someone I look up to...?
You mean in a romantic way?
rows.notes: Female; iseiteki na imi de (in the opposite-sex sense).

rows.en:
So you mean looking up to someone
out of respect, that kind of thing?

Hmm, that's tough.
There are so many, it's almost a problem.

What about you, Luca-kun?
Is there someone you look up to?

Huh. Well, I think that's a good thing.
A competitive spirit really drives you,
after all.
So, think you can beat this rival of yours?
Oh, really?
Don't worry, I'm sure you can do it, Luca-kun!

Not at all.
Anyway, let's finish eating. We'll get our
strength up and give it our all from tomorrow!
Yeah, see you!
(So even Luca-kun has his worries...)
(I'm here for a meal with Luca!)
Hey, Luca.
Think you can catch up with your rival?

I'm still nowhere near them.
Not that I plan on giving up...
I see, I see.
rows.notes: x4: also nml_luk_015 both genders (Luca says he planned to buy lunch too).

rows.en:
Thanks for the meal.
That was really good, wasn't it?

Yeah, eating something tasty
really perks you up, doesn't it?
It really does.
(Being full of energy is what counts most.)
(I'm here for a meal with Luca-kun!)
Hey, Luca-kun.
I see, I see...

(The sunset from Griffith Park is beautiful.
It's amazing that it's all artificial.)
rows.notes: Male, frd_luk_008. Griffith Park from locations.json.

rows.en:
\p-san,
what are you doing here?

Hey, Luca.
Nothing much, just watching the sunset.
Want to join me, Luca?
Oh, yes, I'd love to!

We'll be reaching the new planet soon,
won't we?
rows.notes: x2, Luca; the fleet's search for a new home planet.

rows.en: Maybe so...

Have you thought about what you'll do
once we get there?

Hmm, let's see...
What should I do?
Right...

Maybe it's because things are so good right now?
What about you, Luca? Thought about anything?
rows.notes: Male; juujitsu shiteru = life feels full.

rows.en:
I don't know.
I'd like to take my time thinking about it...
Ha, so you're in the same boat as me, Luca.

Well, while we're at it, I hope it's a
comfy planet to live on. Endless summer,
aloha shirts...

I'd like it to have four seasons,
like Japan on Earth.

Endless summer, no question.
Easy clothes, you know? Aloha shirts?

Just heat gets old fast, you know.
Frontier's already like that, after all.
Why are we getting so worked up over this?
rows.notes: Male; 'we' since both argued (muki ni natte).

rows.en: Yeah, really...
Well, it's getting late. Let's head home.

(A new planet, huh...
I wonder where we'll end up...)

(The sunset from Griffith Park is so pretty...
It's amazing that it's all artificial.)

Oh, Luca-kun.
Nothing much, just watching the sunset.
Want to join me, Luca-kun?
Maybe so...

Hmm, let's see...
I really don't know.

Maybe it's because things are so good right now?
What about you, Luca-kun? Thought about
anything?

Oh, come on, you're in the same boat as me,
Luca-kun.

Well, while we're at it, I hope it's a
comfy planet to live on. You know,
endless summer, aloha shirts...

Somewhere nice and warm is way better.
Easy clothes, you know? Aloha shirts?
Why are we getting so worked up over this?
Well, it's getting late. Let's head home.

(A new planet, huh...
I wonder where we'll end up...)
(I took a walk out to Griffith Park, but...)
Huh, it's Luca.
What's up? What are you doing here?
rows.notes: x3: also female to Ranka in frd_rnk_008.

rows.en:
A change of pace, I guess...
The view here is nice...
I see. Same as me, then.
Well then, I'll be going on ahead.
rows.notes: x2, Luca; osaki ni shitsurei shimasu.

rows.en: Goodbye, \p-san.
...Hey, Luca.
Let's keep our chins up, okay?
I'm fine, really.
rows.notes: x2, Luca; continues in slice 126 ('if you say so').
